info.title: Retail Business Operations API
info.description:
Multi-role REST API for Retail retail platform.

**Roles covered:**
- Sales Manager — transactions, stock alerts, promotions, store KPIs
- Supplier Manager — purchase orders, supplier performance, replenishment
- Business Analyst — sales forecasts, anomaly detection, aggregates

get.description: Returns aggregated daily revenue, transaction count and unit volume for all stores or a specific store. Useful for the morning sales review.

parameters.name: store_id

schema.description: Filter by store. Omit for all.
schema.title: Store Id

parameters.description: Filter by store. Omit for all.

schema.title: Response Daily Sales Summary Sales Summary Daily Get

get.summary: Sales summary over a date range
get.description: Aggregated revenue and units for a given date window per store.

schema.title: Response Sales Summary Range Sales Summary Range Get

get.description: Paginated list of sales transactions. Filter by store, date range, payment method, or customer.

schema.title: Response List Transactions Sales Transactions Get
Response Get Transaction Items Sales Transactions  Sale Id  Items Get

get.summary: Return transactions linked to an original sale

schema.title: Response Get Returns For Sale Sales Transactions  Sale Id  Returns Get

get.description: Returns active stock alerts. Filter by store, status or alert type. Ordered by urgency (PENDING first, then by shortfall).

schema.title: Response List Stock Alerts Sales Alerts Get

patch.summary: Acknowledge or resolve a stock alert
patch.description: Sales manager updates alert status. Resolved alerts require resolution_notes.

get.description: Active promotions or all promotions. Optionally filter by store.

schema.title: Response List Promotions Sales Promotions Get

get.description: Key performance indicators for a store over a given period: revenue, transactions, units, avg daily revenue, top product, return rate.
Ranked by revenue or units sold over the given period.

schema.title: Response Top Products Sales Top Products Get

get.description: Customers ranked by spend. Useful for loyalty tier review.

schema.title: Response Customer Activity Sales Customers Activity Get

get.description: Returns all suppliers, optionally filtered by active status.

schema.title: Response List Suppliers Supply Suppliers Get

get.description: All products this supplier can supply, with unit cost and lead time.
Calculates on-time delivery rate, average lead time, total order value and PO status breakdown for a supplier.
Filterable by store, supplier, status, and date range.

schema.title: Response List Purchase Orders Supply Purchase Orders Get

get.summary: Line items of a purchase order

schema.title: Response Get Po Items Supply Purchase Orders  Po Id  Items Get

patch.description: Transition a PO through its lifecycle: PENDING → APPROVED → IN_TRANSIT → DELIVERED (or CANCELLED). actual_delivery_date required when setting DELIVERED.

get.description: IN_TRANSIT or APPROVED POs where expected_delivery_date < today. Critical for escalation.

schema.title: Response Overdue Purchase Orders Supply Purchase Orders Overdue Get

get.description: Products at or below reorder_point, paired with the optimal active supplier from store_supplier_proximity (nearest + fastest). Returns urgency: CRITICAL (qty=0), HIGH (below min), MEDIUM (at reorder point).

schema.title: Response Replenishment Suggestions Supply Replenishment Suggestions Get

get.description: Full movement ledger. Filter by store, product, movement type or date. Useful for GRN reconciliation and shrinkage audits.

schema.title: Response List Stock Movements Supply Stock Movements Get

get.description: Returns matched OUT + IN transfer pairs grouped by transfer_order reference.
Ranked list of suppliers reachable from a store with distance, transportation mode, cost and estimated delivery time.
Retrieve forecasts with optional actual vs predicted comparison. Filter by store, product, method or date range.

schema.title: Response List Forecasts Analytics Forecasts Get

post.description: Submit a model-generated forecast for a product/store/date. confidence_lower must be < predicted_quantity < confidence_upper.

put.summary: Update actual quantity for a forecast
put.description: Once actual sales data is available, backfill the forecast record.

get.description: MAPE (Mean Absolute Percentage Error) and CI-hit-rate per forecast method. Helps the analyst select the best model for each product category.

schema.title: Response Forecast Accuracy Analytics Forecasts Accuracy Get

get.description: All detected anomalies. Filter by store, date range, deviation threshold or whether they have an associated external event.

parameters.name: unexplained_only

schema.description: Only anomalies with no associated event
schema.title: Unexplained Only

parameters.description: Only anomalies with no associated event

schema.title: Response List Anomalies Analytics Anomalies Get

get.description: Pre-aggregated daily totals per store × product. Faster than querying sales_transactions for trend analysis.

schema.title: Response Daily Aggregates Analytics Aggregates Daily Get

get.description: Month-over-month revenue grouped by store (or across all stores). Includes MoM growth % for the last 12 months.

schema.title: Response Monthly Revenue Trend Analytics Trends Revenue Monthly Get

get.description: Week-over-week revenue for the past N weeks.

schema.title: Response Weekly Revenue Trend Analytics Trends Revenue Weekly Get

get.description: Revenue share and unit volume per category over a date range.

schema.title: Response Category Revenue Breakdown Analytics Breakdown Category Get

get.description: All external events (festivals, weather, strikes, etc.).
For a given external event, calculates the number of anomalies triggered, average deviation % and estimated revenue impact.
For each promotion, shows revenue and units generated during the promo window across active stores. Compares against baseline to calculate lift %.

schema.title: Response Promotion Effectiveness Analytics Promotions Effectiveness Get

get.description: Revenue, units, forecast accuracy and anomaly count for a product broken down by store. Ideal for identifying underperforming locations.
Last N audit log entries for compliance and change tracking. Filter by table, action type or actor.
